types: one CLR public type identity maps to one Ruby constant identity
constructors: retain every .ctor identity; dispatch through initialize
overloads: retain every CLR signature identity in the static contract

refOut.refInput: ordinary typed Ruby value input copied at value boundaries
refOut.multipleOut: ordered Array following any non-void CLR return

arrayTransforms: caller-owned source/destination Arrays; whole and indexed range forms preserve forward overlap order

collections.genericICollection: preserve the CLR interface identity and project its selected typed members directly on the Ruby collection class
collections.genericIEnumerable: preserve the CLR interface identity; GetEnumerator returns Ruby Enumerator without a fake System namespace
collections.enumerationMutation: fail-fast when the backing collection version changes

staticMembers: class methods; struct-valued members return fresh objects

System.IntPtr.validation: inclusive signed range derived from Fiddle::SIZEOF_VOIDP
System.IntPtr.nativeBoundary: two's-complement bit pattern in the canonical fixed-width C carrier; never Fiddle::Pointer

structs: Ruby classes with boundary copies and dup/clone; assignment aliasing is documented
operators: map to Ruby syntax where available and retain op_* identity in static contract
events: retain identity; explicit subscription mapping when implemented

generics.contract: retain CLR arity/signature and reject ambiguous runtime dispatch
generics.runtimeTypeName: each CLR generic type definition Name`N maps deterministically to NameOfT for arity 1 and NameOfT1T2...TN for higher arity
generics.collisionRule: the non-generic CLR identity keeps Name; no alias may collapse it with the generic identity

expectedMemberFormula: reference public members minus enum value__ metadata storage
